data.one_liner: Hero animations on the same page without a Navigator or routes.
data.what_it_does: Provides HeroHere and HeroHereSwitcher widgets to animate a widget from one place to another on the same screen. It uses tags and keys to coordinate the transition when state changes, without needing routes or a Navigator.
use_when: You want shared element transitions between different positions on the same page.
You need tab indicator or sliding segmented control animations without route changes.
avoid_when: You are navigating between distinct routes and can use Flutter's built-in Hero widget.
You only need simple layout repositioning of a single widget without a second matching widget.
strengths: Works on the same page with no Navigator or routes required.
Supports customizable flights, ready-made shuttles (crossfade, flip, scale), and redirect behaviors.
Works across all major platforms including web and desktop.
weaknesses: Requires proper key and tag management between old and new places to trigger flights correctly.
Not intended for inter-route navigation transitions.
data.setup_notes: No native setup or build runner required. Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml.
data.minimal_example:
HeroHereSwitcher(
  child: HeroHere(
    key: const ValueKey('center'),
    tag: 'flippers',
    child: Image.asset('images/flippers.png'),
  ),
)
